name: Local Issue Follow-up Fields Prototype
scenario: Capture who expects a Local Issue, edit follow-up context, and understand it from issue detail.
frequency: daily creation, occasional editing, frequent detail review
frames: Detail / Human review after AI completion
Validation / Missing external requester and stale follow-up

fieldOwnership.aiExecution: derived from invocation or auto-run; read-only

whatNotToShow: external customer represented as an internal user
old task silently defaulted to self
article sourceMode reused as intake channel
visualQaTasks: Confirm self requester hides redundant name and organization fields.
Confirm customer editing exposes external name, organization, channel, commitment, and follow-up fields.
Confirm issue detail separates relation and delivery from derived AI execution.
Confirm progress updates append a record and can update waiting-on and next follow-up.
Confirm historical tasks show unknown with an explicit recovery action.
Confirm validation errors are summarized and attached to their fields.
Confirm desktop and mobile layouts do not overflow horizontally.
